name: Hasty Pudding
text: Belly 1. Start of Combat: if empty, swallow the biggest enemy. Your biggest Ooze permanently gains all of it.
golden_text: Belly 2. Start of Combat: if empty, swallow the two biggest enemies. Your biggest Ooze permanently gains all of each.
